old.Title: Get employee by non-existing id
old.Description: Verify that the API returns 404 status when employee id does not exist
old.Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with non-existing employee id
old.Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found in db'

new.Title: Get employee by non-existing id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns 404 status when employee id does not exist

new.Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found'

old.Title: Get employee with null id
old.Description: Verify that the API returns 400 status when id is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with null id
old.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

new.Title: Get employee with null id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns 400 status when id is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with null id
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

old.Title: Get employee by valid id
old.Description: Verify that the API returns employee details when a valid id is provided
old.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with valid employee id
old.Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee details in response body
